acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Data-independent acquisition; Bottom-up proteomics

cleavage_agent.evidence: The enzyme specificity was set to consider fully tryptic peptides, and two missed cleavages were allowed.

collision_energy.evidence: MS/MS spectra were acquired in high-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) mode with a normalised collision energy of 25 and resolution 15,000 using a Top 20 method, with a target AGC of 2 × 105 and a maximum injection time of 50 ms.

fragmentation_method.evidence: MS/MS spectra were acquired in high-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) mode with a normalised collision energy of 25 and resolution 15,000 using a Top 20 method, with a target AGC of 2 × 105 and a maximum injection time of 50 ms.

instrument.evidence: Peptides were dissolved in 2% acetonitrile containing 0.1% trifluoroacetic acid, and each sample was independently analysed on an Q Exactive HF Hybrid Quandrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific), connected to an UltiMate 3000 RSLCnano System (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

ionization_type.evidence: Peptides (1 µg) were injected on a PepMap 100 C18 LC trap column (300 μm ID × 5 mm, 5 μm, 100 Å) followed by separation on an EASY-Spray nanoLC C18 column (75 μm ID × 50 cm, 2 μm, 100 Å) at a flow rate of 250 nl min−1.

labeling.evidence: inferred: Label-free quantification (LFQ) was enabled with a minimum ratio count of two.
